reviewRequired.note: The source treats kinetic energy as useful output. The 66% is only for that supplied conversion model, not the refrigerator’s overall cooling performance. Refrigerators transfer heat; coefficient of performance is a different measure. Do not infer a running-cost comparison from these data alone.

The source supplies no explicit potential-energy zero, initial speed or loss assumption. A unique equal-KE/PE position is therefore underdetermined; teacher clarification or a scientifically justified conditional answer is required.

The claim that all solar cars are necessarily more efficient than petrol cars lacks a defined boundary and numerical data. Accept a qualified comparison; do not assume photovoltaic conversion and electric motors are lossless.
